prompt.project_info: Create a raw smartphone vacation portrait of an adult woman kneeling on a sunlit ocean balcony or terrace.
prompt.main_subject: An adult woman with deep tan skin, long straight dirty-blonde hair with dark roots, natural skin texture, and a relaxed confident expression. She wears a brown-and-black tiger-print string bikini, black rectangular sunglasses, a thin gold cross necklace, gold bracelet, white wristband, and a nose stud.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium knees-up portrait from a slightly high or eye-level angle while kneeling on a white towel or mat over pebbled concrete. A glass railing with metal posts frames the vast blue ocean and bright sky with scattered clouds. Hands rest naturally at the sides or upper thighs, head slightly tilted, face toward camera.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Direct harsh midday sunlight, high contrast, strong natural highlights on skin and fabric, sharp body-cast shadow on the white mat, tropical luxury vacation atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50–85mm natural focal length, no wide-angle distortion, sharp subject focus, slight ocean background blur, raw high-fidelity smartphone photography, visible natural texture, vertical composition.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Raw high-fidelity smartphone photograph of an adult woman with deep tan skin, long straight dirty-blonde hair with dark roots, and natural skin texture, kneeling on a white towel or mat on a pebbled ocean balcony. She wears a brown-and-black tiger-print string bikini, black rectangular sunglasses, a thin gold cross necklace, gold bracelet, white wristband, and a nose stud. Medium shot from knees to top of head, slightly high or eye-level angle, relaxed confident expression, head slightly tilted toward camera. Glass railing with metal posts behind her, vast blue ocean to the horizon, bright sky with scattered white clouds. Direct harsh midday sunlight, high contrast, strong natural highlights, sharp body-cast shadow, slight ocean background blur, 50–85mm perspective, tropical luxurious sun-drenched vacation mood.
